request: Answer a community member asking whether they should arrive early for the library repair workshop.
source: Doors open at 9:45 a.m. and the workshop begins at 10 a.m. Everyone with a reservation has a seat, so arriving before doors open is unnecessary. Participants should bring the broken item and its power cable if it has one. Large appliances are not accepted.
